lede: Wake Forest carries the stronger underlying team rating — +4.3 against -0.1, a 4.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Purdue +0.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Wake Forest winning 52% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is secondary, where Wake Forest leads Purdue by 93 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
